node.opening: We've had movement around our perimeter today, {playerFirstName}.
node.details: Tracks cross the back lots, and the infected keep drifting against the wind.
node.personal: I've been watching it long enough that every loose branch sounds deliberate.
node.followup: We can add a patrol or keep the group quiet and observe.
node.closing: Whatever caused it, I want us ready before night settles in.
choice.detail: Walk me through what you saw.
choice.offer_help: I'll take the next perimeter check.
choice.press: Show me the trail and I'll read it.
choice.reassure: You can hand the watch to me for a while.
choice.challenge: We cannot let nerves set our pace.
choice.wrap_up: All right. I'll brief the others.
response.detail.open: The trail doubles back near the east fence. That looks intentional.
response.detail.guarded: I saw enough to justify caution, not panic.
response.personal.open: Tired, but better knowing you're paying attention too.
response.personal.guarded: I can finish my watch. Focus on the perimeter.
response.offer_help.open: Good. Pair up and take the quiet route.
response.offer_help.guarded: Take someone with you. I don't want a missing scout added to the problem.
response.press.open: The scuffs are shallow and spaced wide. Whoever made them was moving quickly.
response.press.guarded: Read it yourself, but don't turn a weak sign into certainty.
response.reassure.open: An hour off the line would help more than I want to admit.
response.reassure.guarded: Finish your own work first. Then we'll trade watches.
response.challenge.open: Agreed. Alert is useful; frightened is not.
response.challenge.guarded: Nerves kept me alive long enough to join this group.
response.advice.open: Double the dusk watch and keep the western exit clear.
response.advice.guarded: Listen before acting. Noise will tell us more.
response.wrap_up.open: Good. Keep the briefing calm and specific.
response.promise.open: That's what I needed to hear.
locked.personal: They are not familiar enough with you to discuss that.
locked.skill: You need more Foraging experience to interpret this trail.
locked.personality: Their personality makes that challenge likely to backfire.
locked.promise: They need more approval before trusting that promise.
